_readme: MUSIC tab presets. Two different things, kept separate on purpose: 'recipes' are COMPLETE briefs — one click replaces the description field with editable text; 'tablets' are short modifiers that APPEND to whatever is already in the field. Both are visible in the field, so nothing happens invisibly. Edit freely: this shipped file is merged into ~/.assembler/music_styles.json on launch (local edits win), so a recipe added here reaches the whole team with the next update.

recipes.label: Фітнес-хук 30с
recipes.text: High-energy pop-dance track at 128 BPM in A minor, driving four-on-the-floor kick, bright supersaw synths and claps, instant hook in the first second and one clear peak; confident female alto, punchy and motivating. Structured for a 30-second ad with a clean ending.

recipes.label: Велнес під голос
recipes.text: Soft wellness underscore at 88 BPM in F major, warm felt piano, gentle shaker and airy pads, no busy melodies in the mid frequencies so a voice-over stays clear. Calm, healthy-lifestyle warmth, slow gentle build, clean ending.

recipes.label: K-pop реклама
recipes.text: Bright K-pop track at 124 BPM in B major, glossy synth stabs, slap bass, crisp trap-influenced drums, pre-chorus lift into a big group-vocal chorus; lead female vocal with playful energy plus layered backing chants.

recipes.label: Lo-fi фон
recipes.text: Lo-fi hip hop at 84 BPM in D minor, dusty vinyl crackle, mellow Rhodes chords, soft boom-bap drums and upright bass, sparse and unobtrusive. Instrumental only, no vocals.

recipes.label: Епічний трейлер
recipes.text: Cinematic orchestral build at 100 BPM in D minor, solo piano intro, strings swelling with braams and taiko hits, climaxing in a wall of sound at the end. Instrumental only, no vocals.

recipes.label: UGC-органіка
recipes.text: Casual acoustic pop at 104 BPM in G major, fingerpicked guitar, handclaps and light tambourine, feels homemade rather than produced; friendly male tenor singing close to the mic.

recipes.label: Дерзкий хіп-хоп
recipes.text: Confident hip hop at 92 BPM in F minor, heavy 808 bass, sharp hi-hats and a simple ominous synth motif; bold rap delivery with attitude, gang-vocal hook.

recipes.label: Ретро-синтвейв
recipes.text: 80s synthwave at 112 BPM in A minor, gated drum machine, shimmering analog pads and an arpeggiated bassline, retro-futuristic; smoky female alto with a nostalgic delivery.
